confirmed_detail.quote: The cited sources (src-001, src-013, src-015) quote Houthi spokesman Yahya Saree describing the strikes as "precise and direct," not "proportionate."
confirmed_detail.j1_why: Only src-001 carries that characterisation (verbatim quote "precisi e diretti"; summary: Saree 'called the attacks "precise and direct"'). src-013 and src-015 quote Saree only as saying the strikes targeted 'weapons depots and command and control centres that are managing the aggression against our nation and people' — neither contains 'precise and direct'. The proposed_correction repeats the same misattribution ('the verbatim language used by Houthi spokesman Yahya Saree in src-001, src-013 and src-015').
confirmed_detail.j2_why: Only src-001 carries that wording (verbatim_quote "precisi e diretti"). In src-013 and src-015 Saree's quoted words are "weapons depots and command and control centres that are managing the aggression against our nation and people"; neither contains 'precise and direct'. The same misattribution is repeated in qa_corrections[0] ('the verbatim language used by Houthi spokesman Yahya Saree in src-001, src-013 and src-015').

confirmed_detail.quote: Sources disagree on Elon Musk's company affiliation: most call him owner or founder of xAI (src-003, src-006, src-009), while src-017 describes him as head of 'SpaceXAI (formerly xAI)'.
confirmed_detail.j1_why: src-003 does not call Musk owner or founder of xAI; its actor entry gives his role as 'Owner of SpaceXAI'. Only src-006 and src-009 ('Owner of xAI') match the description attributed to all three.
confirmed_detail.j2_why: src-003 does not call Musk owner of xAI; it lists his role as 'Owner of SpaceXAI' — the same formulation the output attributes only to src-017. Only src-006 ('Owner of xAI') and src-009 ('Owner of xAI') support the claim.
